expected_root_cause: SaveUploadedFile applies chmod to the destination directory after MkdirAll even when that directory already existed. A process may not own an existing directory such as /tmp, so the unconditional chmod returns operation not permitted and prevents the upload.
fix_summary: Check whether the destination directory existed before MkdirAll and only apply the requested mode when this call created the directory.
curation_notes: Issue #4622 and PR #4702 were checked against the fix commit and regression test; the buggy SHA is the direct parent of the functional fix commit.
